register.labelZh: BEAT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: beat down 可以描述猛烈陽光;beat back 和 beat off 則可以描述擊退火勢、襲擊者或競爭。；beat somebody out 可以表示在競爭中取得機會;beat somebody to something 則表示比別人先到達或先行動。；beat a seller down 或 beat a price down 可以清楚表示議價,使對方接受較低價格。；beat up on somebody 可以描述不公平的批評;beat yourself up 則提醒我們不要過度責怪自己。
register.summaryEn: Beat down can describe strong sunlight, while beat back and beat off can describe stopping fire, attackers or competition. Beat somebody out can describe winning an opportunity, while beat somebody to something shows that one person arrived or acted first. Beat a seller down or beat a price down clearly describes persuading someone to accept a lower price. Beat up on somebody describes unfair criticism. Beat yourself up reminds us not to blame ourselves too much.
